description: Microsoft Excel 2010 is open with a stock market data spreadsheet (stock_market_data.xlsx). The spreadsheet contains historical stock data with columns including Date (A) and Close price (E). Select the Date column (A) and Close column (E) data, then insert a Line Chart to visualize the stock's closing price trend over time. Make sure the chart is placed on the same sheet as the data. Save the file using Ctrl+S.
